user.title: Connect to Crestron Home
user.description: Enable the Web API in the Crestron Home setup app (Installer Settings → System Control Options → Web API Settings) and paste the REST API token.

reauth_confirm.title: Crestron Home token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The processor no longer accepts the saved token. Firmware updates can reset it. Copy the current REST API token from the Crestron Home setup app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the processor's REST API.
error.invalid_auth: The processor rejected the API token.
